subject: General Science
title: Transport in Plants

outcomes.text: describe absorption of water and mineral salt in plants,
investigate factors affecting transpiration in plants,
describe the significance of transpiration in sustainability of plant life,
appreciate the role of transport in plants.

content: Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts
inquiry_questions: Why is transport in plants important?
coreCompetencies:
Citizenship: as the learner sensitises the community on the importance of watering and manuring plants to sustain plant growth.
Learning to learn: as the learner reflects on experiments on factors affecting transpiration in plants.
values:
Unity: as the learner engages in assigned roles while working with others in the process of investigation of factors affecting transpiration.
Patriotism: as the learner sensitises the community on the importance of watering and manuring plants to sustain plant growth.
pcis:
Safety and security: as the learner observes safety precautions while carrying out experiments in groups to investigate factors affecting transpiration in plants.
Environmental issues: as the learner creates awareness in the community on the use of fertilisers (Di-ammonium Phosphate, Calcium Ammonium Nitrate, Urea) in boosting crop production.
transcription_policy: Source wording retained;line breaks/bullets normalised. Source pixels remain authority.
notes: Source suggests translocation experiments;this design interprets an attributed research case and fictional phloem evidence rather than unsafe ring-barking/radioactive tracer handling. Actual learner investigation is separately provided for environmental/structural transpiration factors. Written research interpretation is not certified as performed phloem experimentation.
Awareness activity uses teacher-approved class/school audience and conditional nutrient/water reasoning;no unsupervised fertiliser/manure handling or site-specific application prescription.
